test_groups.purpose: Validate all created/modified JSON docs/manifests load with Python json.load.
must_not_do: Do not mutate loaded files
Do not run pipeline scripts
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: python -c "import json, pathlib; [json.load(open(p)) for p in paths]"

test_groups.purpose: Record and compare stat metadata for protected baselines and canonical outputs.
must_not_do: Do not write into protected paths
Do not promote staged outputs
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: find/stat protected paths before and after validation task

test_groups.purpose: Ensure documentation-only tasks do not launch Stage-A or World Model Layer.
must_not_do: Do not execute stage_a_demo.py
Do not create large world-model outputs
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: scan command log for stage_a_demo execution; optionally process grep only

test_groups.purpose: Check stable occupancy map references are derived RSLG-SLAM products and load as expected.
test_groups.layer: Layer 2: Formal Artifact Layer / Layer 3: Navigation Interface Layer
must_not_do: Do not regenerate maps in static validation
Do not treat maps as external GT
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: load YAML/NPZ metadata and verify provenance fields when implemented

test_groups.purpose: Protect connector ids, floor transition edge truth, and route chain invariants.
must_not_do: Do not replace vt_1_centerline_e001 with vt_1_centerline_e003
Do not use manual stair centerline as source
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: assert transition_edge == vt_1_centerline_e001 and route includes vt_1/vc_vt_1

test_groups.purpose: Protect obj_175 curtain smoke-test contract and generated approach candidate semantics.
test_groups.layer: Layer 2: Formal Artifact Layer / Layer 3: Navigation Interface Layer
must_not_do: Do not use object centroid as navigation target
Do not claim full object-navigation benchmark
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: assert object_id=obj_175, label=curtain, room_14/floor_2, candidate=generated_ring_037, centroid flag false

test_groups.purpose: Validate canonical cross-floor route chain and formal route contracts.
must_not_do: Do not infer dataset-side localization accuracy
Do not use simulator navmesh
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: assert route chain room_2 -> room_3 -> vt_1/vc_vt_1 -> room_7 -> room_13 -> room_14

test_groups.purpose: Check runtime inputs can be exported from formal artifacts without launching runtime.
test_groups.layer: Layer 3: Navigation Interface Layer / Layer 4: Runtime Validation Layer
must_not_do: Do not launch Gazebo/RViz/Nav2/AMCL
Do not write runtime logs in static tests
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: static path/schema check for map/route/robot-profile inputs

test_groups.purpose: Verify artifact provenance excludes forbidden source types.
test_groups.layer: Layer 0: Input Layer / Layer 1: World Model Layer / Layer 2: Formal Artifact Layer
must_not_do: Do not use external GT floorplan/map
Do not use manual object target pose
Do not use simulator navmesh as world-model source
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: scan provenance fields for forbidden source markers and fail closed

test_groups.purpose: Static validation tasks must not start ROS/Gazebo/RViz/Nav2/AMCL.
must_not_do: Do not execute launch/run/publish/player scripts
Do not create runtime screenshots/videos/logs
test_groups.suggested_command_or_check: denylist command-log check for gazebo, rviz2, nav2, amcl, ros2 launch unless explicitly runtime task
